```python
import os, sys, platform, hashlib

# 1) Full inventory, including hidden files, with hashes
print("### FULL INVENTORY OF CWD AND CHILD DIRS ###")
for root, dirs, files in os.walk('/tmp/abb-tablegpt-piokphsv'):
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in {'__pycache__'}]
    for f in sorted(files):
        p = os.path.join(root, f)
        h = hashlib.md5(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()[:12]
        print(f"{p:60s} {os.path.getsize(p):>9,}B  md5:{h}")
print("\n### /tmp TOP LEVEL (incl. dotfiles) ###")
for f in sorted(os.listdir('/tmp')):
    p = os.path.join('/tmp', f)
    kind = 'DIR ' if os.path.isdir(p) else 'FILE'
    print(f"  {kind} {f}")

# 2) Where did this kernel actually come from?
print("\n### RUNTIME ###")
print("python:", sys.version.replace("\n"," "))
print("executable:", sys.executable)
print("platform:", platform.platform())
```
